content.user_title: Assess Market Risk and Design Hedges
content.value_statement: Market uncertainty makes risk signals and hedge choices difficult to compare. This skill routes requests into structured fear, volatility, hedging, and research-quality workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes each request to one focused risk workflow.
Builds ticker fear scores from volatility, technical, volume, and options signals.
Classifies VIX regimes using levels, percentiles, history, and term structure.
Compares protective puts, collars, and put spreads for existing positions.
Evaluates hedge costs, protection floors, upside caps, breakevens, and scenario outcomes.
Audits research workspaces for stale profiles, thesis drift, orphan items, and missing monitoring.
limitations: Requires LLMQuant Data for current market, options, portfolio, and research information.
Produces a data-limited note when required inputs are unavailable.
Does not guarantee investment outcomes or replace professional financial advice.
Needs position size, horizon, and budget details for precise hedge comparisons.

use_cases.title: Review Volatility Conditions
use_cases.description: Classify the current VIX regime and translate it into sizing, protection, and premium-selling guidance.

use_cases.title: Compare Position Hedges
use_cases.description: Compare risk-defined hedge structures for an existing holding using cost, payoff, and sensitivity measures.

use_cases.title: Audit Research Quality
use_cases.description: Find stale profiles, thesis drift, orphan themes, outdated evidence, and missing alerts that require attention.

prompt_templates.title: Check the VIX Regime
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the current VIX regime using LLMQuant Data. Report the timestamp, percentile, term structure, strategy posture, and missing inputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of broad market volatility

prompt_templates.title: Score Ticker Fear
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a fear score for [ticker]. Explain each component, event risk, confidence, action bias, and any unavailable data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a single equity

prompt_templates.title: Design a Position Hedge
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare hedges for [shares] shares of [ticker] at [cost basis]. Use a [budget] budget and [horizon] horizon. Show scenarios and tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced protection planning for an existing position

prompt_templates.title: Run a Research Health Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my research workspace for stale profiles, thesis drift, orphan items, outdated evidence, and missing monitors. Rank actions by urgency. Make no changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across portfolio research records

output_examples.input: Assess the current VIX regime and explain the appropriate options posture.
output_examples.output: VIX tier: caution. Backwardation confirms stress, so reduce short-volatility exposure and compare defined-risk protection. The report includes timestamp and percentile.

output_examples.input: Compare a protective put and collar for 500 shares with a three-month horizon.
output: Protective put: preserves upside but has the higher cash cost.
Collar: lowers hedge cost but limits gains above the call strike.
Scenario results compare loss floors, caps, breakevens, and implied-volatility sensitivity.

output_examples.input: Check my research workspace without changing any records.
output_examples.output: Health score: 72. Highest priorities are two stale profiles, one triggered thesis, and three missing monitors. No records were changed.

best_practices: Provide the asset, horizon, drawdown tolerance, and required decision.
Supply position size, cost basis, and hedge budget when requesting option protection.
Review timestamps, stale notices, assumptions, and missing inputs before acting.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a high fear score as an automatic buy signal.
Do not use VIX alone for single-name options decisions.
Do not request workspace changes without naming the authorized records.

faq.question: What data source does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses LLMQuant Data for market, volatility, options, portfolio, and research information.

faq.question: Can it create a ticker fear score?
faq.answer: Yes. It combines available volatility, technical, volume, put-call, and options-flow signals into a documented score.

faq.question: Which hedge structures can it compare?
faq.answer: It can compare protective puts, collars, put spreads, and position reduction when supported by available data.

faq.question: Does it change research records automatically?
faq.answer: No. It changes profiles, theses, or alerts only after the user authorizes specific updates.

faq.question: What happens when data is missing?
faq.answer: It identifies each missing input, labels fallback assumptions, and produces a data-limited risk note.

faq.question: Is the output financial advice?
faq.answer: No. The output supports risk analysis and comparison, but users remain responsible for investment decisions.
